Name: Pelican Palette
Author: blinxxy
Description:
[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966215-14876816.png[/img]

[size=4][i]"Fireflies are pure light on dark. You can't paint them. I keep trying." - Sable[/i][/size]

Pick up a brush. [b]Pelican Palette[/b] adds painting to Stardew Valley: a minigame as hands-on as fishing, a new skill, an art supply shop in Cindersap Forest, and Sable, the restorer who runs it.

Set an easel down anywhere (in your farmhouse, by the river, on the summit) and paint what you see: a parsnip, a basket of fruit, a friend who'll sit for you, the view in front of you. Mix your colours against the light, copy the picture cell by cell, and sell, gift, frame or varnish what you make.

[b][i][u](WARNING: This mod is very WIP. Its just something I'm working on in my very limited spare time. Feel free to give it a try.)
[/u][/i][/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966230-1986739154.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Painting[/b][/size]
[quote]Mix colours on a fishing-style bar, then copy the reference cell by cell
Paint before the light runs out, and catch inspiration sparks for more
Still lifes of anything in your bag, portraits of friends, the view outdoors, or your own original
Small, medium and large canvases
Glazing on medium canvases and highlights on large ones: the minigame grows with you
Quality from normal to iridium, set by your accuracy and your skill
Paint on linen, perfectly, and make a [b]Masterpiece[/b]
Learn colours like recipes; spend paint from your Palette; grind your own in a Pigment Mill
Wooden, Enamel and Iridium Palettes: tubes go straight in, and a palette set down stores your paint
Five brushes, from hog bristle to iridium, that wear like fishing tackle[/quote]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966260-1146247263.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966274-381244379.png[/img]

[size=4][b]The Painting Skill[/b][/size]
[quote]A new skill from level 1 to 10, with its own skills-page bar (via SpaceCore)
New tools as you level: broad brush, ruler, mirror, dropper
Bigger canvases, rarer pigments, higher quality
Six professions: Plein Air, Steady Hand, Visionary, Gallerist, Patron's Favorite, Prolific[/quote]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966290-1191583838.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966286-912174614.png[/img][/center]
[center]
[quote]Sell to Pierre, to the art shop for more, or through the shipping bin
Consign up to three paintings at Sable's gallery: they sell in a few days for more again
A new subject sells for more; the same one painted over and over in a week, for less, until Monday
A painting record of every subject you've painted, with milestone rewards
Villagers' commissions on the art shop's board, portraits included
Everyone loves an iridium painting, and nobody dislikes one
Frame paintings to hang on your walls
Varnish them in a Varnishing Cabinet, which cures them like wine in a cask[/quote]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966305-837876692.png[/img]

[quote]A cottage shop west of the path down from Marnie's
Canvases, pigments, paint, brushes, frames, palettes, varnish and more, with stock that grows with your skill
A commission board, a consignment gallery, and your painting record at the counter
And, for one special evening, a gallery opening[/quote]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966311-775229348.png[/img]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792977312-458319658.png[/img][/center]

[center][/center]
[center][quote]Sable (they/them), a former museum restorer from Zuzu City
Hundreds of lines of dialogue, a full schedule, and every festival
Winter and island outfits
Heart events at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 14 hearts
Dateable and marriageable, with their own spouse room and patio, and they still keep the shop[/quote]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966476-1230709474.png[/img]

[quote][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9 or later
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/quote]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966482-1199597726.png[/img]

[quote]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher and SpaceCore
Unzip the download into your Mods folder. You'll get one PelicanPalette folder holding two mods; keep both
Run the game through SMAPI
On your second day, a letter arrives from the new art shop[/quote]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966483-1045784623.png[/img]

[quote]Stardew Valley 1.6.15
Safe to add to an existing save
Works with Stardew Valley Expanded
Works in co-op multiplayer
Other mods that change the stretch of Cindersap Forest west of Marnie's path may overlap the shop[/quote][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966892-1003313713.png[/img][/center]

[b]Do I need to start a new save?[/b]
No. Pelican Palette is safe to add to an existing save. The art shop's letter arrives the next morning.

[b]How do I remove it?[/b]
Sell or trash your paintings, easels and art supplies first, then delete the PelicanPalette folder.

[b]The minigame is too hard (or too easy)![/b]
Open the config (Generic Mod Config Menu, or PelicanPalette/PelicanPalette/config.json). [i]Relaxed[/i] has no light meter, flat colour on every canvas and free paint. [i]Hard[/i] runs the paint out, never pauses the light and pays 20% more. You can also give yourself more light.

[b]Where do I get more colours?[/b]
Buy pigments from Sable, or pick up a tube of a colour you don't know: you learn it on the spot. A Pigment Mill grinds tubes from clay, coal, stone, flowers, berries, minerals and gems.

[b]Is it multiplayer compatible?[/b]
Yes. Each player has their own skill, record, commissions and consignments. Paintings don't move the clock in multiplayer, where time is shared.

[b]Is Sable romanceable?[/b]
Yes, by anyone. Sable uses they/them pronouns.

[b]How do I make a Masterpiece?[/b]
From Painting level 8, paint on a linen canvas: iridium quality, five stars, Inspired, with every glaze and highlight in place.

[b]Where's the full guide?[/b]
On the [url=https://github.com/blinxxy-0/PelicanPalette/wiki]Pelican Palette wiki[/url]: every item, recipe, pigment, price and heart event.

[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54599/54599-1792966672-2127074592.png[/img]

[b]blinxxy[/b]
Design, code, art, writing

Pixel art made with PixelLab and finished by hand to match the game.
Source code on [url=https://github.com/blinxxy-0/PelicanPalette]GitHub[/url] (MIT). Art and writing all rights reserved; translations welcome.
Built with [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].

[size=2]Thanks to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, and to Pathoschild and spacechase0 for the frameworks that make mods like this possible.[/size][/center]
